messages:
alex: Starting rollout for release 2026-03-21-rc4 in 5 minutes. Change window 45m. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates.

maria: standing by. I'll watch p50/p95 and 5xx. Will call quickstop on threshold breaches. :eyes:

sanjay: quickstop thresholds reiterated: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 2 consecutive 1m buckets. Also check token-cost anomaly dashboard.

priya: if we need to abort, prefer pin-and-drain to full revert. Pin target: v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Pin steps in runbook.

alex: deploy-bot, initiate canary for rc4 region=us-west-2 weight=10%
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for 2026-03-21-rc4 · region=us-west-2 · weight=10% · canary_id=4312401234
deploy-bot: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-quickstop · rollback helper: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-pin

maria: small blip in p50, p95 looks ok for now.

eng-oncall: I'm available to execute quickstop/rollback if needed. Say "eng-oncall: execute quickstop" to proceed.

alex: seeing a smoke from assistant service, investigating. Hold escalation unless it widens.

sanjay: note: pin command: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --reason "quickstop"` — runbook has RBAC details. If pin fails we have an abort fallback.

maria: p95 jumped to 420ms for ~30s, hitting quickstop criteria.

alex: initiating quickstop. eng-oncall please execute. I'll post release notes blurb.

eng-oncall: execute quickstop now.

eng-oncall: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --force --origin canary-4312401234` — completed. Traffic pinned and canary drained.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary 4312401234 marked quickstopped by eng-oncall. Traffic pinned to v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/4312401234 · Postmortem checklist attached.

priya: adding release note: "2026-03-21-rc4 quickstopped due to elevated assistant tail latency. Traffic pinned to previous stable. Investigation ongoing." Will upload perf diffs.

alex: follow-ups: 1) collect KV cache hit/miss, 2) replay stage load with production prompt mix, 3) check kernel/quantization change impacts. Assigning owners in incident doc.

maria: starting perf captures and logs now. Will share links. :thumbsup:

sanjay: reminder: runbook has fast-abort if pin can't be applied: `deployctl abort --release 2026-03-21-rc4 --kill-relay` — use only if pin fails or rollback gaps detected.

alex: locking the changelog to prevent accidental re-rolling. We'll reopen thread when we have RCA or a safe re-release plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for 4312401234. Canary aborted and pinned.

priya: scheduling a 20m sync and adding timeline to incident doc.

eng-oncall: monitoring off-thread. Ping if you need handoff.

alex: closing for now. Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in incident doc and reopen when ready. :white_check_mark:
